1.17.1

Improvements

  • Reduce repeated decoding when listing local backups by caching validated event counts, while continuing to verify actual file contents.
  • Encode the final event document directly when saving, reducing JSON work while retaining conflict checks, atomic writes and Agent retry protection.
  • Keep the latest 100 event undo operations to bound retained full-document snapshots during long sessions. Native text-editing undo remains separate.

Fixes

  • Fix incremental builds omitting the Sparkle updater framework after build-product cleanup, with recovery and path-safety tests.

Developer preview. Not notarized by Apple.

1.17.1

改进

  • 优化本地备份列表：缓存已验证内容的事件计数，减少大量事件和备份时的重复解码；仍校验实际文件内容。
  • 保存事件时直接编码最终文档，减少重复的 JSON 编码与解码，保留冲突检测、原子写入和 Agent 重试保护。
  • 事件撤销历史保留最近 100 次操作，限制长时间使用时完整快照的持续积累；文字编辑的原生撤销保持独立。

修复

  • 修复清理构建产物后，增量构建可能遗漏 Sparkle 更新框架的问题，并增加恢复与路径保护测试。

开发预览版，尚未经过 Apple 公证。
